last_message: I created `docs/philosophy.md`, a new kind the map already defines but no page yet existed for. It records the "one more service" rule as a tenet — a new service earns its place only when Postgres can't do the job and two volunteers can restore it, with the card-gateway-style hosted-service exception — and links it to the two existing decisions that already applied it (sessions, background jobs), plus the just-settled Elasticsearch-vs-Postgres-search argument from `notes/issue-70.md`. Next time this comes up, the proposal can start from this page instead of re-litigating it.
